text:
maya: Nightly e2e smoke failed perf gate for longseq suite — p95 jumped +26% vs baseline. failing job: https://ci.redwood/job/12345 logs attached. can someone rerun or bisect? @sasha
infra-ci-bot: Job 12345 FAILED — perf_gate_p95 threshold=0.20 measured=0.253. Rerun available: https://ci.redwood/job/12345/rerun
sasha: on it. quick question: which commit range did nightly pick up? suspect a1b2c3d -> a1b2c3f from the release branch
maya: looks like that range, PR 482 had a runtime warmup tweak and a small batching change. tagging @cheng
cheng: that warmup tweak changed KV cache priming order, could explain cold p95 regression on long sequences. i'll take a look at profiles. @liam any infra config changes last night?
liam: no infra deploys in that window from my side. grabbing logs now. maya can you post the stack traces or perf dumps?
maya: pasted minimal stackdump + trace link in ticket. quick rerun command i use:
```bash
# retry the failing job with same env
./ci/tools/retry_job.sh --job 12345 --suite=e2e-longseq --env=nightly\```
maya: queued a rerun (job 12346) while we look
infra-ci-bot: Job 12346 STARTED (rerun of 12345) — runner: g4-nightly-7
sasha: first rerun finished: throughput OK but p95 still high (0.238). attaching perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/d/longseq/nightly/12346
infra-ci-bot: Job 12346 FINISHED — perf_gate_p95=0.238 (threshold 0.20) — gate still failing
cheng: consistent with warmup change hypothesis. if reruns are stable-red, propose bisect between a1b2c3a..a1b2c3f. i'll schedule bisection tomorrow morning (PST) if no immediate rollback.
maya: agreed. assigning to cheng for bisect. liam — can you try reverting the warmup tweak on a branch and run local e2e (longseq) to validate quickly?
liam: will attempt revert and run local e2e in ~60m. will post results here.
oncall-roster-bot: @eng-runtime oncall notified: perf-gate-nightly (severity: low) — please post updates in this thread
sasha: FYI canary showed a small uptick around the same commit window but not as pronounced. i've added notes to the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INF-987
maya: thanks all. leaving thread open. if bisect points to PR482 we can either revert or patch the warmup logic. updating the ticket with rerun metrics and next steps.
